recent.text: The Steph Curry-less Warriors have started the 2Q on an extended 28-14 run. Cut a 15-point deficit to 1 with guile, grit, and a whole lot of Yaxel Lendeborg. The rookie has 16 points, 7 rebounds in 18 minutes. Just hit a face-up, pull-up middie over Kevin Durant.
recent.author: Danny Emerman

recent.text: The Warriors are going big against the Rockets and giving Al Horford his first start of the season, theoretically freeing Draymond Green to open on Kevin Durant (and Horford on Sengun). Steph Curry Brandin Podziemski Yaxel Lendeborg Draymond Green Al Horford
recent.author: Anthony Slater

recent.text: Yaxel Lendeborg will get part of the Kevin Durant assignment tonight in Houston. Here is Steve Kerr on the early career defensive “test” for the rookie. https://t.co/UZ8xK2scDm

recent.text: Will Richard has been cleared to play tonight for the Warriors. Steve Kerr said Richard's preference was to play through the torn UCL in his left thumb rather than get surgery. He will have a splint on his thumb. He tested it out at shootaround/pregame.
recent.author: Anthony Slater

recent.text: Will Richard has his left thumb taped and is expected to play through the UCL tear, eschewing possible surgery route. Steve Kerr: “When the staff told us it was either give it a try or surgery, he said right away, ‘I’m going to give it a try.’”
recent.author: Danny Emerman

recent.text: The Warriors have been impressed with Brandin Podziemski's quiet fourth-year consistency. He's a team-high +97, including a +37 when Steph Curry is off the floor. Career-highs in points, assists, shooting 40% from 3 on high volume, defending well. NBA Today hit on Podziemski https://t.co/AcZSeBnJ5n
recent.author: Anthony Slater

recent.text: Warriors guard Will Richard (thumb) upgraded to probable for tonight in Houston. He was testing it out, both dribbling and defending, at shootaround this morning. Seems like Richard will try to play through the torn UCL in his thumb instead of opting for the surgery route.
recent.author: Danny Emerman
